csv_scope_of_work: The San Joaquin Delta Community College District ( District ) intends to improve the Stockton campus ( Campus ) by updating network cabling for legacy buildings at the District s Stockton Campus using the Design-Build Delivery ( DB ) method authorized by the California Education Code sections 81700 et. seq., and other applicable laws, to design and construct the following project at the Stockton Campus: Technology Cabling Project (hereinafter referred to as the Project ).

title: Design-Build for 2026 Technology Cabling Project
short_description: Design-build procurement for campus-wide network cabling upgrades in legacy college buildings.
project_scope: Upgrade network cabling for legacy buildings at the San Joaquin Delta Community College District Stockton campus using the design-build delivery method. The project concerns campus technology cabling improvements across existing buildings; no gross floor area, building count, or structural spans are stated.
services: Design-build services for programming, civil engineering, construction/project management, electrical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a technology cabling and electrical infrastructure upgrade, not a structurally driven project.
- Structural engineering is listed, but no significant load-bearing, long-span, bridge, roof, or special structure scope is described.
- University campus context is generally of interest, but this package is focused on cabling rather than complex building structures.
- Design-build delivery offers some planning component, yet the technical core does not align well with sbp's profile.
fee_explanation: No explicit design or structural engineering fee is stated. Available information for a rough estimate: total construction cost is 35,000,000 USD; scope is campus technology cabling upgrades in legacy buildings under a design-build procurement; disciplines include civil, electrical, and structural engineering, but no allocation by discipline is provided.
contracting_authority: San Joaquin Delta Community College District, 5151 Pacific Ave, Stockton, CA 95207-6304, USA. Contact: Glenn Aguon. Phone: 209-954-5151. Fax: 209-954-5601. Email: glenn.aguon@deltacollege.edu. Website: https://procurement.opengov.com/portal/deltacollege/projects/269333

Stage: RFP/RFQ. Source lists total construction cost as 35.0M. Although structural engineering is requested, the described scope is mainly network cabling modernization.
